mapper.sql: ID, RECEIVER_MEMBER_ID, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, IS_READ, CREATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT n.ID, n.RECEIVER_MEMBER_ID, n.NOTI_TYPE, n.CONTENT, n.TARGET_TYPE, n.TARGET_ID, n.IS_READ, n.CREATED_AT FROM NOTIFICATION n JOIN MEMBER m ON m.ID = n.RECEIVER_MEMBER_ID WHERE m.USER_ID = #{userId} AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR n.ID < #{cursor}) ORDER BY n.ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION n JOIN MEMBER m ON m.ID = n.RECEIVER_MEMBER_ID WHERE m.USER_ID = #{userId} AND n.IS_READ = 'N'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (RECEIVER_MEMBER_ID, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, IS_READ) VALUES (#{receiverMemberId}, #{notiType}, #{content}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{isRead})
